reading.body:
This entry cannot be used to assess AI campus significance. The reverse-geocoded address, 3850 E McDowell Road, resolves to an apartment complex, not a data center facility. QTS's published Phoenix-metro portfolio lists PHX1 downtown, PHX2, PHX3 in Glendale (a 375-acre, 750 MW campus acquired in July 2022), PHX4, and an Avondale facility; none correspond to a McDowell Road location. No independent confirmation of QTS operating a data center at this address was found.

The ranked position reflects a data error rather than a facility fact. If this row were removed, QTS's confirmed Arizona presence would be represented by its documented campuses alone. Arizona has 56 mapped facilities total and 512 MW of published capacity across four operators; four of those campuses are QTS sites confirmed through their own materials.

To assess whether QTS matters to AI scaling in Arizona, refer instead to PHX3 Glendale, the published 750 MW campus, and QTS's other confirmed Phoenix-metro facilities, which together represent the operator's actual regional footprint. This row is flagged as a mapping error and carries no usable specification data.
